items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I did it when I went out to do Dick Gibson's jazz party

ctx.x: Bill was a little afraid that I wouldn't be identified enough unless I did "Loch Lomond." So there it goes again on that album.
"You're Driving Me Crazy," I had been doing for quite some time. I did it when I went out to do Dick Gibson's jazz party (unintelligible) that year.
It's an up tempo number and I like it. It fits in pretty good.
